leadText: DJ Mary (Japanese: クルミ Kurumi) is a DJ in Goldenrod Radio Tower. She co-hosts the famous radio program, Professor Oak's Pokémon Talk, with Professor Oak.
plainText:
DJ Mary (Japanese: クルミ Kurumi) is a DJ in Goldenrod Radio Tower. She co-hosts the famous radio program, Professor Oak's Pokémon Talk, with Professor Oak.

==In the core series games==
Mary is a famous celebrity in both the Johto and Kanto regions. Due to her popularity, many people travel from Kanto to Johto to listen to her show. She can be found at the Goldenrod Radio Tower, where she also winds up as one of Team Rocket's hostages when the organization invades the tower. Once Team Rocket is defeated, she will thank the with a Pink Bow /BrightPowder . After the player has defeated Lance at the Indigo Plateau, Mary will show up with Professor Oak, attempting to interview the player before Lance takes them to the Hall of Fame.

According to the player's Pokégear calls with Buena, Mary has a weight problem. Despite not being a , Mary has one Pokémon, , but since it was always making her drowsy, she traded it with one of her fans for a .

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon the Series===
====History====
===== =====
DJ Mary debuted in Air Time!, where she was first seen at the Goldenrod Radio Tower. appeared on her show to talk about his Pokémon and his aspirations. She was due to narrate the next radio segment, a drama series, but had earlier destroyed the radio station's tape reels. Team Rocket, disguised as the Dugtrio Trio, and Ash's group helped fill in the voice actor roles while DJ Mary narrated the radio drama about "Prince Goldenrod". She was forced to improvise after Team Rocket added their own twists to the script, but she managed to tie everything together.

In Will the Real Oak Please Stand Up?, DJ Mary and were going to do a live show in Maroon Town, but Team Rocket got wind of this and disguised themselves as Oak and Mary. With the help of Nurse Joy, a quiz show determined who was the real Oak and DJ Mary.

=====Pokémon Chronicles=====
In Oaknapped!, DJ Mary informed that Oak disappeared before he could tape a segment for her show. Tracey and Ritchie later caught up with her and Officer Jenny at 's TV station. Together, they located Oak and defeated his kidnappers, Butch and Cassidy.

====Character====
DJ Mary is well known for her celebrity interviews and radio segments, which are broadcast across the Kanto and Johto regions. She is good friends with and often works with him. She is also a celebrity in her own right and has her own fan-club.

DJ Mary worries about her broadcast schedules, though she is composed and upbeat during her performances. She is quick-thinking and can easily go impromptu during a radio interview, as seen in Air Time!, when she noticed 's overwhelming nervousness.

====Voice actors====
 

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
 
====History====
===== =====
Mary is first seen hosting a radio show when , a fan of hers, bursts into the recording session. Gold reveals that Mary's , Smea-Smea, painted his face earlier and wishes to have his revenge on it. Gold's anger leads into an argument with Whitney, who was the one who gave Smea-Smea to Mary in the first place. After the argument gets good ratings for the show, the Radio Director, Hirō, decides to market it by organizing a race with Gold and Whitney as the competitors. Although confused at the whole situation, Mary acts as one of the hosts covering the event.

Later, Mary joins Whitney, Hirō, and the Pokémon Association Chairman in traveling to the Mahogany Gym in order to warn Pryce of , which had been challenging all of the Gym Leaders in Johto.

At the Indigo Plateau, Mary appears as one of hosts of the Pokémon League. She gets caught up in the Masked Man's attack of the League with his army of mind-controlled s. With Smea-Smea's attacks that it copied from , Mary helps stop one of the Masked Man's ice dolls permanently. After the Masked Man was defeated, Mary returned to her life as a radio show host.

===== =====
In Epilogue, Mary appears as one of the people that came to visit the as a result of Scott wishing on .

===== =====
Mary appears as a commentator at the Pokéathlon. There, she meets with Gold again, who had come to compete.

====Character====
She is a radio show host at the Goldenrod Radio Tower as well as a singer known for the song "Boy and his Lapras". 

====Pokémon====
This listing is for Mary's Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga.

=====Formerly owned=====
 

===Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys===
 
 
DJ Mary appears in Let's Use Fighting Type Pokémon!!. In the English translation, she is still referred to by her Japanese name, Kurumi. She hosts a Pokémon tournament organized by the Pokémon Day Care.

===Pokémon Pocket Monsters===
DJ Mary appears in Showdown at the Radio Tower!!. She ends up becoming a hostage of 's during his takeover of the Radio Tower. She is rescued by and his Pokémon in the end.
